personality_one_liner: A highly structured, fast, and clear bookkeeping utility tailored for Nigerian shop owners, using precise color-coding and native iOS card layers to minimize cognitive load.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for dashboards, tighter lists for fast scanning. Maintain clear whitespace for cards.

dont's: No blur on utility app screens, focus on solid colors and 1px borders as per explicit brief.

screens.name: Splash & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app to shop owners with vibrant Nigerian retail context imagery and a clear CTA.
screens.layout: Full-bleed imagery with a bottom gradient scrim, large Manrope headline, and a sticky green button at the bottom.

screens.name: Auth & Business Setup
screens.purpose: Collect user credentials and shop details smoothly.

states.error: Inline red text or coral toast.

screens.layout: Teal-top header (#014747). White surface below. Form fields with 11px radius, 1px border. Bottom sticky green button.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level overview of sales, cash flow, and quick actions.

states.empty: Welcome message with prompt to record first sale.

screens.layout: Teal header fading to canvas. Total sales card (white, 14px radius). 4x2 shortcuts grid. KPI tiles and vertical bar charts. Green floating action button (FAB) in the center of the bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Customers List & Profile

states.empty: Empty box illustration with 'No customers yet'.

screens.layout: Segmented control (bg #EAF0EE, radius 10) for filtering. List of white cards for customers. Profile features a teal-top header and tabular ledger using IBM Plex Mono for all currency values.

screens.name: Invoices
screens.purpose: Track issued invoices, status chips, and overdue amounts.
screens.layout: List with status chips (pill radius 99) in amber (pending) or coral (overdue). New invoice flow is a 3-step wizard with sticky footer.

screens.name: Quick Sale Register
screens.purpose: High-speed POS interface for rapid checkout.
screens.layout: Central product grid with images/colors, side or bottom cart panel, sticky green checkout/tender button. Automatically increment quantities.

screens.name: Stock
screens.purpose: Manage inventory, pricing, and stock levels.
screens.layout: List layout. Amber chips for low stock. Item detail uses teal-top header. Bottom sheet (radius 20) for adjust stock action.

onboarding_shop_owner.alt: Nigerian shop owner in retail store

empty_box_illustration.alt: Empty box illustration for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the specific colors provided: Brand Green #00C98D for the single primary action per screen. Deep Teal #014747 for headers.
Use Manrope (weight <= 500) for all UI text, and MUST use IBM Plex Mono for all money figures, invoice numbers, dates, and tabular data.
Cards must be white (surfaceSecondary) with exactly 1px #E5EEEB border and 14px radius.
Input fields get 11px radius. Buttons get 12px radius. Bottom sheets get 20px top radius. Chips get 99px pill radius.
The bottom tab bar must have Home, Sales, a center green FAB (+), Stock, and More. The active tab color is green-700 (#019068).
Implement 'Teal-Top' screens for Home, Customer Profile, Invoice Detail, and Item Detail. This involves a #014747 header background that gradients or stops at 132px into the canvas #F3F7F5.
Do not use blur/glassmorphism; adhere to the solid clean layout requested. Light theme only.
Limit font weight to 500 max. Ensure text colors meet contrast constraints using onSurface (ink), onBrandPrimary (dark green), etc.
